name: Westcliff discovery board
context: Career work: bring prospects to Westcliff for employee training, including indigenous community corporate training. Target decision-makers are line managers who control training budgets in Canadian industries. In-person outreach beats cold research; success means booked training engagements.

name: 2Nimbus dental software
context: Dental specialist software rolling out to Canadian dental clinics (~10 clinics using it). Current strategy: make the first dentist's rollout indispensable — seamless for receptionists, detailed feedback from nurses and staff, fast bug fixes — before expanding. Success means clinics rely on the product daily and refer others.
